title: the skills still describe the old audit and scope behaviour
desc: plan-change tells the author to re-audit only after editing the plan and that moved is expected; implement-change says impl check fails on anything outside the plan and gives stale reasoning for not re-auditing. Both predate the baseline (WB-12) and the scope attribution (WB-10). Nothing mentions wb task done at all, so no skill closes a ticket. SKILL.md is what steers behaviour, so stale text here outranks a stale README.
